findings.headline: Migrate this attr: namespace attribute to a standard HTML attribute.
findings.why: Solid 2 removes the attr: namespace; attributes use standard HTML behavior. The bare attribute name (type) replaces the namespaced form.
findings.guidance: Remove the attr: prefix from this attribute, keeping the attribute value unchanged.

findings.headline: Migrate this bool: namespace attribute to a standard HTML boolean attribute.
findings.why: Solid 2 removes the bool: namespace; boolean attributes use standard HTML behavior. The bare attribute name (disabled) replaces the namespaced form.
findings.guidance: Remove the bool: prefix. A standard HTML boolean attribute is true when present and false when absent — replace explicit true/false values with attribute presence/absence.
